Flyer Press Catalogue

LazyCreation | Habibok v7.6

—
Auto-save is off
Branch
Each branch keeps its own product list, photos, layout and colours — switching branches never disturbs the others.
Each branch already carries its own address and phone. Change the dates here once a week and all five lines update together.
Or just hover the banner area on the flyer and press ⤴ Upload banner.
This is the breathing room between the banner and the offer-valid bar, so the two never touch.
Drag this to make the header banner bigger or smaller. Dragging it switches the auto-fit off.
 
Make your Canva design exactly that many pixels and it drops in without a single crop.
Product data empty
The client corrected the sheet and sent it again? Save it over the same file and press Refresh — the new prices land on the flyer straight away. Nothing you designed is lost, and you never have to reset anything.
With Sync on the app looks at the sheet every 2 minutes and on every Refresh; whatever the client changed lands on the flyer with a coloured chip on the box (NEW · PRICE · RENAMED · NOT IN SHEET) until you have checked it. One tab of the sheet = one branch: open the tab in Google Sheets first, then copy the link, so the gid is in it. The flyer mirrors the sheet: a line deleted or replaced there is deleted or replaced here too. Boxes you added on the flyer yourself stay.
On Department by department it does not matter what order the client typed the sheet in — nuts land in Grocery, fish lands in Fresh Fish, and the flyer comes out sorted. Load a corrected sheet later and it simply re-sorts; nothing you designed is lost.
Read from the sheet. Raise it if you want spare empty boxes at the end.
Your column choices are kept every time the sheet is re-read, so a refresh can no longer send the new rows into the wrong price column. Press this only if the sheet's layout really changed.
Whole rows move together, so a name can never end up beside another product's price.
Nothing picked — Shift+click a box on the flyer, or select a box with ⠿ and press Space.
Product images 0
Dropped new pictures into the folder, or replaced an old one? Press Refresh — it re-reads the folder, updates the pictures that changed and fills the empty boxes. No disconnecting and reconnecting.
This is what makes the pictures look big — most product photos carry a wide empty margin, and trimming it costs nothing.
On Strict a box is left empty rather than filled with the wrong picture. A size or a number on its own (1KG, 400GM) never counts as a match, and one photo is never used twice.
Every product on this branch that has no photo yet, one per line. The .csv also gives the file name the app would like best — save a photo under that name and it drops straight into its box.
Filenames don't need to match exactly — matching is by the words in the name. Photos are kept per branch, so two branches never share a picture by accident.
Found the product picture on a website? Right-click it, choose Copy image, then hover the box on the flyer and press Ctrl+V. The box you are hovering is ringed in green so you always know where it will land. You can also drag a picture straight from a browser tab, or a file from Explorer, onto a single box.

No download, no renaming, no folder — and Ctrl+Z puts the old picture back.

If a site only hands over the address instead of the picture, the app will say so: use Copy image, not Copy image address.
The sticker always sits in a corner of the picture, so it can never cover the product name or the price. Use the ☆ button on any box to switch that one box on or off by hand.
The shadow follows the real cut-out shape of the photograph, not a rectangle, and it is drawn the same way on screen, in the PNG, in the SVG and in the PDF.
Your pictures already arrive as cut-out PNGs, so this normally stays off. Turn it on for a batch that came in on a plain white or grey background. A photo that is already cut out is skipped, and a real photographic background is refused rather than butchered — only background that touches the border is lifted, so a white plate in the middle of the product survives.
Nothing in your folder is touched. If a result is wrong, press Refresh photos from the folder and the original comes straight back.
A product box on an A4 sheet is about 40 mm wide, which is roughly 470 px at 300 dpi. Anything past 1200 px is weight the flyer carries for nothing — print quality does not change.
Cover page off
Fish on the right, fruit and vegetables in the middle, rice and oil on the shelf at the bottom — each zone takes the departments you give it, in the order of the sheet. What finds no zone goes to page 2 as usual.
The library is shared by every branch; each branch picks its own. Click one to use it, ✕ to remove it.
Drag a product from one zone onto another to move it there. A zone with no department takes anything. Numbers are millimetres on the A4 page (210 × 297).
Pages & layout
A wider gap is what keeps Canva from gluing two product boxes into one object.
Below 100% the picture sits smaller inside its box; above 100% it fills more of the box and the edges are cropped. It can never spill out of its own box.
On Spread a page of 52 products in a 5 × 7 grid comes out 5,5,5,5,4,4,4 — every row runs the full width, so the sheet never shows a hole. Use + Boxes above to add a part row by hand: 7 × 7 + 1 = 50.
Moving boxes: click ⠿ under a box to pick it up, then click the box it should go before (left half) or after (right half). Arrow keys nudge it, Delete removes it, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies it next to another box, ＋ (or Ctrl+D) adds a copy of the box right after it, Space or Shift+click picks it for a bulk change, click a photo for corner handles that size it, Esc lets go. Zoom: Ctrl + mouse wheel, Ctrl + / −, or the buttons bottom-right — only the flyer zooms.
Design
The label is drawn on screen, in the PNG, the SVG and the PDF exactly the same way. Letters, digits and $ € £ ¥ print everywhere; symbols such as ₹ ৳ ﷼ ₨ are outside what the PDF engine can embed, so for those use the code (INR, BDT, SAR, PKR).
Click a tag to use it on the whole flyer. Colours come from Name & price; the currency and NOW ride along automatically.
Click any circle to drop that gradient in. Every colour box below also takes a typed colour code — paste #0F7A3D and press Enter.
A soft box shadow lifts every product off the page. Keep it gentle for print — strong shadows eat ink and can look muddy on newsprint.
Pull this down and the box fill turns into a soft tint over the page colour, so the photograph reads clearly. 100% is the plain white box you have now.
Tag fill 2 makes the tag a gradient (same as fill 1 = flat). The band colours are for designs 8–11, the ones with a name band along the bottom of the box.
Name ↔0% Name ↕0% Photo ↔0% Photo ↕0% Price ↔0% Price ↕0% Old price ↔0% Old price ↕0%
A share of the box: −100% is the whole height (or width) up or left, +100% the whole way down or right, so every edge is in reach on every page. Nothing leaves its box — a tag already in a corner only moves the other way. This shifts every box; for one box, drag the photo, the price tag or the old price with the mouse, or press ⤧ under the box for half-millimetre steps.
Works offline from a built-in Gulf-market grocery dictionary — TOMATO PER KG becomes طماطم للكيلو, colours and sizes go after the noun, units are converted, and a brand or model number is left as it is. It is a dictionary, not a translator: a word it does not know stays in English, and every line can be corrected by clicking it on the flyer. An Arabic name that came in from your sheet is never touched by the first button.
The old price comes from the old price column of your sheet, or from the price that was there before you re-loaded a corrected sheet. It is always drawn smaller than the offer price. Type NOW (or anything else) in the right-hand box and it appears on the tag in front of the new price.
A heading uses one whole row, and it follows the order you chose under Product data.
Single pages off
A4 gives one product a whole page. The 16:9 card fits two or three side by side — handy for a screen or a social post.
The name and price sizes above and this picture size are what make one product fill its page the way you want. Below 100% the picture sits smaller; above 100% it fills more and the edges are cropped. It can never spill outside its own area.
Finished the flyer in Canva? Drop the PDF, PNG or JPG here and every product box becomes its own page — same one click, but starting from your Canva artwork.
No flyer loaded.
The PDF keeps the name and price as real text, one card to a page — so Canva can never glue two products together.
WhatsApp off
Use {branch}, {valid}, {count}, {date} — they fill themselves in.
WhatsApp does not let any website attach a file for you — that is their rule. So this does the next best thing: the picture goes on the clipboard and the chat opens straight away. Ctrl+V then Enter. On a phone the flyer is attached for you properly.
Export
If Canva still joins two boxes: leave this on Plain drawing, tick the Arial box, and widen Gap between boxes under Pages & layout to 4–6 mm.
Every product box becomes its own PDF page. Canva imports each page on its own, so nothing can ever be glued to the box next door — and the price and name stay editable text. Drop the page you want onto your single-product design.
More than one page comes down as a single .zip, the way Canva does it.
PDF and PNG carry the full background — nothing comes out white.
Lock the app
This builds a locked copy of the whole application. The copy asks for your password before anything opens. It is not a password check that somebody can delete — the entire app is encrypted, so a wrong password leaves nothing inside the file to run.
At least 8 characters. Letters + numbers + a symbol is best.
There is no back door. If the password is forgotten, that locked file can never be opened again — not by me, not by anybody. Keep one unlocked copy somewhere only you can reach.
Danger zone
Clears the loaded list, layout and colours. Photos stay.
